fullContent:
Krimi Mudgar Ras – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference – Rasatantra Sara (first part); edition 13; 408 – 409. 
 Introduction 
 Krimi Mudgar Ras is an ayurvedic formulation that is known to contain mixture of fruitful herbs and minerals. It is one of the best medicine that is known to treat intestinal worms originated due to kappa. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Honey 
 Suddha parade (Herbal purified Mercury) – 12 grams 
 Suddha gandhaka (Herbal purified Sulphur) – 24 grams 
 Ajamoda (Trachyspermum roxburghianum) – 36 grams 
 Vidanga (Embelia ribes) – 48 grams 
 Suddha Kuchla (nux vomica) – 60 grams 
 Palasha (Butea monosperma) – 72 grams 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Took the ingredients 
 Took all the ingredients in its given quantity. 
 Mixed all the ingredients and grounded with honey of sufficient amount to make its paste. 
 Now took the quantity up to 125 mg and made its pills. 
 
 Dose 
 One to two pills, two to three times a day, with kashaya of musta. 
 After three days, take laxative pills on the fourth day. 
 Indications 
 
 Intestinal worms – helminthiasis 
 Indigestion 
 Fever 
 Vomiting 
 Loss of appetite 
 Hiccups 
 Sneezing 
 Stomach pain 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Poisonous effects can occur due to over dosing. 
 Avoid during pregnancy and lactation. 
 Take the medicine under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
